Live PC dashboard for the Car Thing (DeskThing), by CutSmokey.

- Six tiles you can rearrange: CPU with temperature, clock with seconds, RAM, any disk, GPU, network, fans, CPU power, uptime
- Dark, light, or auto (day/night) theme
- Text, number and graph size settings
- Refresh from 0.25 s to 5 s
- Live 3D preview at http://localhost:8893/

**Install:** in DeskThing, open Downloads, click the + tile and paste `https://github.com/mohdbushnaq/deskthing-system-monitor`. You can also download the zip below and load it with Add App.
